_doc: Maps CA CCRC universe entries to obligor-level credit files. Sub-community entries in ca_ccrc_universe.json roll up to their obligated group; per task instructions, financial/outcome data is collected ONLY at obligated-group level.

humangood_ca_og_rollups.note: Universe lists 5 HumanGood sub-communities as separate entries (Plymouth, Royal Oaks, Piedmont, Valle Verde, White Sands), but task instruction says treat all 12 as ONE credit obligor → all rolled into humangood_ca_og.json

community_universe_entries_rolled_up: San Francisco Towers / St. Paul's Towers (Oakland)
Casa de Manana (La Jolla — referenced in universe.unit_mix.note)
front_porch_rollups.note: Front Porch + Covia (merged 2020) → 10+ CA communities all roll up. Friends House (Santa Rosa) appears to have joined Front Porch post-Covia but kept as standalone entry given LOW confidence in universe.

excluded_with_reason.Pacific Retirement Services — Mirabella: Universe marks had_outstanding_muni_bonds_2025=false; planned but no CA muni bond outstanding as of 2025. INCLUDED in universe only for tracking — not active CA obligor; no obligor file created.
